k: A blind lawyer and masked vigilante in Hell's Kitchen
Daredevil, the blind lawyer guarding Hell's Kitchen
A lawyer leading the fight against Mayor Fisk
st: Matt fights Hell's Kitchen's crime lords by night and, in a new armored suit, beats Wilson Fisk and leaves him to the police.
Daredevil clashes with the Punisher, fights the Hand beside Elektra, and reveals his secret to Karen.
Matt joins Jessica, Luke and Danny against the Hand and is buried with Elektra as Midland Circle collapses.
Nursed back to health at the orphanage, Matt foils Fisk's frame-up and sends him back to prison.
In a flashback, Daredevil fights Maya Lopez to a draw during a job she carries out for Fisk.
As Peter Parker's lawyer, Matt gets the charges against him dropped and catches a brick thrown through the window.
In Los Angeles, Matt faces Jennifer Walters in court, then teams up with her as Daredevil against Leap-Frog's thugs.
After Bullseye kills Foggy, Matt hangs up the suit, then returns as Daredevil to save Angela from Muse.
Matt takes a bullet for Fisk, survives the Task Force, and rallies honest cops to resist the mayor's martial law.
Matt leads the resistance, reveals he is Daredevil at Karen's trial, and is jailed after Fisk leaves New York.

k: A Union Allied secretary framed for murder
Nelson and Murdock's assistant, turning reporter
A reporter for the New York Bulletin
Matt's partner at Nelson, Murdock & Page
st: Framed at Union Allied, Karen joins Nelson and Murdock, digs into Fisk with Ben Urich, and kills James Wesley.
Karen helps defend Frank Castle, starts writing for the Bulletin, and learns that Matt is Daredevil.
Karen waits out the Hand's attack under police protection and mourns Matt after Midland Circle falls.
Still Frank's friend, Karen publishes a bomber's letter and is taken hostage by him until Frank frees her.
Karen confronts Fisk, survives Dex's attack on Clinton Church, and rejoins Matt and Foggy as a partner.
Karen visits a wounded Frank in the hospital and sets off the fire alarms to help him escape.
After Foggy's death Karen moves away, then returns to help Matt and Frank uncover Fisk's plans for Red Hook.
Karen fights Fisk beside Matt, is arrested at a City Hall protest, and goes free when her case is dismissed.

k: Matt's best friend and law partner
Matt's best friend and law partner
A lawyer at Jeri Hogarth's firm
Matt's partner at Nelson, Murdock & Page
st: In a flashback, Foggy and Matt win an early case for his old neighbor Ray McCoy and give him their savings.
Foggy opens Nelson and Murdock with Matt, learns he is the vigilante, and stands with him to bring down Fisk.
Foggy leads Frank Castle's defense, splits with Matt over his secrets, and takes a job at Jeri Hogarth's firm.
At Hogarth's firm, Foggy gets Luke Cage out of prison and later mourns Matt after Midland Circle.
Foggy offers to help Jeri fight her partners after her diagnosis, but she turns him away.
Foggy represents Luke in Cockroach's assault suit and finds him a paid appearance to cover the settlement.
Foggy runs for district attorney against Fisk and helps bring Agent Nadeem's testimony to light.
Celebrating with his friends at Josie's, Foggy is shot dead by Bullseye.

k: A nurse who patches up vigilantes
A former nurse who helps the city's heroes
st: Nurse Claire finds a wounded Matt in a dumpster and becomes his medic and confidante.
Claire takes care of Luke Cage after Jessica shoots him to break Kilgrave's hold.
Claire treats the Hand's victims at Metro-General and quits when the hospital covers it up.
Back in Harlem, Claire helps Luke survive Diamondback's Judas bullets and kisses him before his arrest.
Training at Colleen's dojo, Claire joins Danny and Colleen against the Hand in Anzhou and New York.
Claire brings Luke and Danny together and helps plant the explosives under Midland Circle.
Claire clashes with Luke over his anger and asks him to leave.

k: A veteran reporter at the New York Bulletin
st: Ben works with Karen to expose Wilson Fisk, until Fisk breaks into his apartment and kills him.

k: A Catholic priest and Matt's confidant
st: Father Lantom hears Matt's confessions and challenges him on the devil he sees in Wilson Fisk.
Lantom counsels Matt as he weighs putting the mask back on.
Lantom shelters the injured Matt and later Karen, and is killed by Dex shielding her at Clinton Church.

k: A nun at the orphanage where Matt grew up
st: Sister Maggie nurses Matt back to health and is revealed to be his mother.
Maggie hides Karen at the church and helps Matt and Karen slip away from the FBI.

k: An honest NYPD officer and Foggy's old friend
st: Officer Mahoney, Foggy's old friend, tips Nelson and Murdock off to their first client, Karen Page.
Mahoney is among the officers at the precinct when Kilgrave takes control of it.
Daredevil gives Mahoney the credit for capturing the Punisher.
Mahoney investigates the hotel bombing and questions Karen, Madani and Billy Russo.
Mahoney stands with Matt's friends at Father Lantom's funeral.
Mahoney hunts Frank, lets him walk away after the ambulance crash, and agrees to a story that leaves him out.
Chief of Detectives Mahoney helps Matt reach Karen in police detention.

k: The blind master who trained Matt as a boy
st: Stick returns to destroy the Black Sky and leaves New York after Matt beats him.
Stick reveals that Elektra worked for him in his war on the Hand, and mourns her with Matt.
Stick warns the Defenders of the Hand's plan and is killed by Elektra.

k: Matt's old flame, a trained assassin
st: Elektra pulls Matt into her fight with the Hand and dies saving him from Nobu.
Revived as the Black Sky, Elektra kills Stick and Alexandra, then stays with Matt as Midland Circle collapses.

k: A machinist who builds armored suits
st: Forced to make armor for Fisk, Melvin builds Matt's Daredevil suit.
Melvin upgrades Matt's suit and makes armor for Elektra.
Forced to copy the suit for Fisk, Melvin tells Matt the impostor is an FBI agent, and is arrested.

k: Editor-in-chief of the New York Bulletin
st: Editor Mitchell Ellison rejects Ben Urich's story on Fisk and fires him.
Ellison helps Karen dig into the Punisher and gives her a job at the Bulletin.
Hurt in the fake Daredevil's attack on the Bulletin, Ellison pressures Karen to name the vigilante.
After Fisk leaves the city, Ellison hires BB Urich at the Bulletin.

k: Owner of a Hell's Kitchen bar
st: Josie serves Matt, Foggy and Karen at her bar in Hell's Kitchen.
Josie's bar hosts Cherry's retirement party when Bullseye attacks.
Matt and Karen hide out at Josie's bar until the Task Force raids it.

k: A lawyer at Landman and Zack, Foggy's ex
st: Marci, Foggy's ex, helps him find the evidence that brings down Fisk.
Now living with Foggy, Marci urges him to run for district attorney against Fisk.

k: A New York assistant district attorney
st: ADA Blake Tower feeds Daredevil leads and becomes district attorney after Reyes is killed.
Tower is on the scene when Diamondback takes hostages at Harlem's Paradise.
Tower prosecutes Mariah Dillard after her arrest.
Tower resists going after Fisk until Matt and Foggy bring him Agent Nadeem's testimony.

k: An FBI agent assigned to Fisk's deal
st: Agent Ray Nadeem works Fisk's deal, then learns the truth and turns on him with Matt's help.
Nadeem testifies against Fisk to a rigged grand jury and is killed by Dex.

k: A tenant fighting eviction in Hell's Kitchen
st: Elena, one of Nelson and Murdock's first clients, refuses to leave her building until Fisk has her killed.
In flashbacks, boxer Jack Murdock raises Matt alone and is killed for winning a fight he was told to throw.
Foggy's brother Theo runs the family butcher shop, which Foggy thinks of joining while Matt is missing.
After Ray's death, Seema gives Foggy the video confession that exposes Fisk's crimes.
Investigator Jessica Jones faces Kilgrave, the man who once controlled her, and ends him by snapping his neck.
A missing person case leads Jessica to the Hand, and she fights them beside Matt, Luke and Danny.
Jessica digs into IGH, finds her mother alive, and loses her when Trish shoots Alisa.
Jessica hunts the killer Gregory Sallinger, then stops Trish's killings and sends her to the Raft.
Now a mother, Jessica fights Fisk's Task Force with Matt and reunites with Luke.

k: A bar owner with unbreakable skin
st: Bar owner Luke Cage falls for Jessica, is controlled by Kilgrave, and is shot in the head by her to stop him.
Luke takes on Cottonmouth, Mariah and his brother Diamondback, then is arrested for his old prison escape.
Freed with Foggy's help, Luke tracks the Hand through Harlem's kids and fights them as one of the Defenders.
Luke battles Bushmaster, reconciles with his father, and takes over Harlem's Paradise as Harlem's new sheriff.
Luke visits Jessica and tells her that sending his brother to the Raft was the hardest thing he ever did.
Back from CIA work overseas for Mr. Charles, Luke reunites with Jessica after Fisk's fall.

k: Jessica's adoptive sister, a radio host
st: Radio host Trish Walker, Jessica's adoptive sister, helps her hunt Kilgrave.
Trish shelters under police protection with the heroes' friends while the Hand strikes.
Trish chases the truth about IGH, takes Malus's procedure for powers, and shoots Alisa dead.
As a masked vigilante, Trish turns to killing, until Jessica stops her and she is sent to the Raft.
Kept on drugs by Kilgrave to spy on Jessica, Malcolm gets clean and helps her fight back.
Malcolm waits out the Hand's attack under police protection with the heroes' friends.
Malcolm investigates for Jessica, falls out with her over Trish, and goes to work for Jeri Hogarth.
Malcolm quits Hogarth, helps Jessica stop Trish, and is handed the keys to Alias Investigations.
Lawyer Jeri Hogarth hires Jessica and fights a bitter divorce while Kilgrave targets her.
Jeri hires Foggy away to her firm.
Jeri proves Danny Rand's identity in exchange for a contract with Rand Enterprises.
Jeri warns Jessica off the case and keeps the fallout away from her firm.
Diagnosed with ALS, Jeri fights her partners and leaves with enough money to start her own firm.
Jeri defends Sallinger, tries to help Trish flee the country, and loses Kith.
Forced by Kilgrave to kill her parents, Hope is jailed, then takes her own life to free Jessica to act.
Detective Clemons doubts Jessica, then guards the proof of Kilgrave's power until Will Simpson kills him.
Flashbacks show Dorothy taking in Jessica to boost Trish's fame and pushing Trish hard as a child star.
Dorothy bails Trish out of jail and worries as her daughter falls apart.
Dorothy asks Jessica to find Trish, rejects her daughter's powers, and is murdered by Sallinger.

k: The new superintendent of Jessica's building
st: Building super Oscar Arocho warms to Jessica after she saves his son Vido and gets papers for her.
Oscar and Vido still live in Jessica's building as she hunts Sallinger.
Vido is kidnapped by his mother until Jessica and Alisa bring him home.
Detective Costa believes Jessica's story and works with her while Alisa is on the loose.
Costa is sent on leave after Sallinger's evidence vanishes, then offers Erik work with the police.

k: An empath who senses people's evil
st: Erik helps Jessica hunt Sallinger, joins Trish's crusade, then helps Jessica stop her and is offered police work.
Gillian makes Jessica take her medication and pushes her and Trish to settle their differences.
Kith loses her husband to Jeri's schemes, accepts her help in a case, then breaks it off with her.
Rescued from her pimp by Malcolm, Brianna gets sober and begins a relationship with him.
Flashbacks show Kilgrave forcing Jessica to kill Reva, Luke's wife.
Flashbacks show psychologist Reva at Seagate Prison, where she helped put Luke through Burstein's procedure.

k: A detective with a robotic arm
st: Detective Misty Knight chases Harlem's crime bosses, doubts Luke, then helps clear his name.
Misty helps the Defenders against the Hand and loses her arm to Bakuto.
With a new robotic arm, Misty returns to the force, hunts Bushmaster, and takes charge of her precinct.
Misty helps Colleen find Danny and brings a police task force to capture Davos.

k: A former gangster who runs a Harlem barbershop
st: Pop gives Luke work and a safe place, then is killed when Tone shoots up his barbershop.

k: A chess master and regular at Pop's
st: Bobby helps Luke keep Pop's barbershop open and finds the files that clear Luke's name.
Bobby leaves Harlem to become an organ donor for his sick daughter.
Connie rents Luke a room above her restaurant, which Cottonmouth destroys with a missile.
Paid by Mariah to frame Luke, Candace agrees to tell the truth, until Shades kills her.

k: A Harlem kid selling videos of heroes
st: D.W. sells videos of Harlem's heroes in action.
D.W. runs Luke's merchandise and an app that tracks his whereabouts.

k: An NYPD inspector over Misty's precinct
st: Inspector Ridley takes over Misty's precinct and pulls her badge after she assaults Claire.
Now deputy chief, Ridley helps Misty uncover Nandi Tyler's betrayal.

k: A Harlem pastor, Luke's estranged father
st: Pastor James Lucas is protected by Luke from Bushmaster's men, and the two begin to reconcile.
Captain Ridenhour runs an informant inside Mariah's crew, until the informant, Comanche, kills him.

k: The heir to Rand Enterprises, back from the dead
st: Presumed dead for 15 years, Danny returns as the Iron Fist, reclaims his company, and fights the Hand.
The Hand uses Danny to open their door, until the Defenders save him and bring down Midland Circle.
Danny teams up with Luke to hunt Bushmaster and wreck his nightshade lab.
Davos steals the Iron Fist, Colleen takes it back, and Danny leaves to find Orson Randall with Ward.

k: A sensei at a Chinatown dojo
st: Sensei Colleen Wing helps Danny fight the Hand, then breaks from Bakuto when she learns his faction is the Hand.
Colleen fights the Hand's fingers, kills Bakuto, and helps plant the explosives at Midland Circle.
Colleen helps Misty cope with losing her arm and brings her a new robotic one.
Colleen takes the Iron Fist from Davos and becomes Chinatown's new protector.

k: Harold Meachum's son, running Rand Enterprises
st: Ward works against Danny under Harold's grip, then turns on his father and helps clear Danny's name.
Ward helps save Danny from Davos, learns he will be a father, and leaves New York with Danny.

k: Ward's sister and a Rand executive
st: Joy welcomes Danny back, then learns of her father's lies and meets with Davos about Danny.
Joy turns on Davos and survives his attack, then tries to return to a normal life.

k: Danny's father, co-founder of Rand Enterprises
st: In flashbacks, Wendell Rand dies with his wife when their plane crashes on the way to Anzhou.
Lei Kung's teachings guide Danny when he takes the Hand's challenge.
In flashbacks, Lei Kung names Danny the winner of his duel with Davos, Lei Kung's own son.
Bethany tends to Danny's wounds, reveals she is pregnant with Ward's child, and chooses to raise it alone.

k: A teen in a Chinatown street gang
st: BB helps Danny reach Colleen and steal back Davos's bowl, and is killed standing up to his old gang.

k: A Marine veteran hunting his family's killers
st: The Punisher wages war on the gangs behind his family's murder, is jailed, then escapes to finish the job.
Presumed dead, Frank teams with Micro to expose Cerberus, kills Rawlins, scars Billy Russo, and is cleared.
Frank protects Amy Bendix from John Pilgrim, kills Billy Russo, and fully takes up the Punisher mantle.
Frank fights beside Matt, is captured by Fisk's Task Force and held at Red Hook, then tricks a guard to escape.
Frank wipes out the Gnucci family, survives Ma Gnucci's bounty, and returns to his war as the Punisher.
Frank clashes with Spider-Man, shelters MJ on his boat, and hits Peter with a shot meant for Jean Grey.
Curtis runs a veterans' support group, patches Frank up, and survives Lewis Wilson's bomb with Frank's help.
Curtis helps Frank hunt Billy Russo and protect Amy, and survives John Pilgrim's attack.

k: A presumed dead NSA analyst called Micro
st: Micro teams with Frank to take down Cerberus, then has his death faked so he can go home to his family.
Sarah grows close to Frank, is taken by Russo's men, and is reunited with a living David.
Agent Madani chases the truth about Cerberus, loses her partner Stein, and survives a shot from Russo.
Madani hunts Billy Russo with Frank, pushes Krista Dumont out a window, and takes a job with the CIA.

k: Dinah Madani's partner at Homeland Security
st: Agent Stein backs Madani's Cerberus investigation until Billy Russo kills him.
Hernandez helps Madani take the Cerberus case to the CIA and frees Frank with a clean slate.
Hernandez reprimands Madani for her visits to Billy Russo.

k: A deputy director of the CIA
st: Marion James forces Rawlins out and joins Hernandez in freeing Frank with a clean slate.
James advises Madani to let Frank and Billy Russo kill each other.

k: A Cerberus veteran living off the grid
st: Gunner, who leaked the Kandahar footage, fights off Rawlins's soldiers beside Frank and dies of his wounds.

k: Frank's wife Maria and their children Lisa and Frank Jr.
st: Frank's memories show Maria, Lisa and Frank Jr., killed in the shootout at the Central Park carousel.
Visions of Maria and Lisa haunt Frank, and Lisa stops him from killing himself at their graves.

k: A teen grifter on the run
st: Hunted by John Pilgrim, Amy bonds with Frank and leaves to start over in Florida.
Beth spends a night with Frank, is shot in the bar fight, and is threatened by Pilgrim in the hospital.
Frank chooses to protect Dre and his family during the bounty siege, and Dre's daughter gives him a paper rose.

k: A retired cop turned Matt's investigator
st: Retired cop Cherry learns that Matt is Daredevil, works as his investigator, and joins the resistance to Fisk.
Cherry survives a Task Force beating and a heart attack, then helps guard Matt at Karen's trial.

k: A former prosecutor and Matt's law partner
st: Kirsten opens a firm with Matt and helps him win Hector Ayala's acquittal.
Kirsten defends Jack Duquesne, records a key witness, and serves as Karen's counsel with Matt.
Therapist Heather dates Matt, kills Muse when he attacks her, and joins Fisk as Mental Health Commissioner.
Haunted by Muse, Heather turns on Karen and ends up putting on Muse's mask.

k: A father secretly fighting crime as White Tiger
st: Matt wins Hector's trial by revealing he is White Tiger, but Hector is gunned down on his next patrol.
Angela pushes Matt to find her uncle's killer and is rescued by Daredevil from Muse.
Wearing Hector's amulet, Angela becomes White Tiger and fights the Task Force beside Matt and Jessica.
Soledad loses her husband when Hector is gunned down after his acquittal.
Arrested by the Task Force at a bodega, Soledad is held at Red Hook until Angela and Matt free her.

k: Ben Urich's niece, an online journalist
st: BB covers Mayor Fisk while quietly seeking to expose him for her uncle's murder.
As 'Mayor Kingpin', BB leaks Fisk's secrets, escapes Daniel Blake's trap, and is hired by the Bulletin.
Detective Kim negotiates during the bank robbery and joins Matt's honest cops against Fisk.
Kim keeps Matt and Karen posted and helps guard Matt at Karen's trial.
Commissioner Gallo plans to work against Mayor Fisk, who finds out and kills him.

k: Jessica Jones and Luke Cage's daughter
st: Jessica raises young Danielle while she joins Matt's fight against Fisk.
Governor McCaffrey threatens Fisk's free port, survives his assassination plot, and pushes him into exile.

k: A Task Force officer who wants to help
st: Taken hostage by Karen, Saunders gives Daredevil his Red Hook card, and Powell later kills him.

k: First mate of the Northern Star
st: Savva records his testimony against Fisk for Kirsten, and Buck Cashman kills him.

k: Maya's uncle, still tied to Fisk
st: Henry refuses to help Maya at first, then stands with her and kills Zane at the powwow.
Chula shares Maya's visions, makes her a special garment, and fights Fisk's men with her power.

k: A grandfather figure who runs the pawn shop
st: Skully gives Maya a new prosthetic leg and tells her that Chafa was the first Choctaw.
Bonnie is caught up in Maya's war, kidnapped by Fisk, and fights back at the powwow with Maya's power.
Biscuits helps Maya hit Fisk's train and takes out Fisk's men with a monster truck.
Taloa dies in a car crash, then appears to Maya in a vision and tells her their legacy will echo through her.
In a flashback, Chafa emerges into the world at Nanih Waiya.

k: A Choctaw stickball player in 1200 AD
st: In a flashback, Lowak's hands glow as she wins a stickball game for her people.

k: A Choctaw girl in the late 1800s
st: In a flashback, Tuklo's power awakens and she saves her Lighthorseman father from an ambush.
